engine.cpu_reference: /home/arenalabs/umr_factory_code (umrf.pipeline.run_umr + umrf.pipeline.postprocess, called by pipeline/run_qa.py with outputs redirected to this robot)

scale_correspondence.scaling: UMR smpl_scale = robot_height / human_height per clip (robot_height 1.83303 m inferred from slots)
scale_correspondence.hoi_policy: shared beta0 correspondence (reuse_across_smplx_betas); no per-clip training

contact_patches.rule: a region is in solid contact if min clearance over its PATCH points is in [0, 1.0 mm] (>= 1 point; a point, an edge or a small patch is enough). Points outside every patch never carry contact.
contact_patches.foot: ankle_pitch_link points in the lowest 2.0 cm of the foot mesh (own frame): sole + toe/heel/side rims; ankle housing excluded; 58/136 (L) points
contact_patches.hand: wrist_yaw_link + hand_link (120 L / 119 R points); the surface region L/R_hand also holds wrist_roll/wrist_pitch links (= distal forearm tube, 84/88 pts) which are moved to the forearm patch
contact_patches.forearm: elbow_link + wrist_roll_link + wrist_pitch_link (elbow contact = forearm patch near the elbow)
contact_patches.knee: whole shin (left/right_knee_link): kneeling puts the knee cap and the shin front on the floor

self_collision.filtered_by_mujoco: parent-child body pairs only (MuJoCo default filterparent); list in assets_check.json
self_collision.reason: no collision-geom pair overlaps at qpos0 or T-pose (closest non-adjacent rest gap: pelvis|left_hip_roll 6.2 mm, torso|shoulder_roll 10.5 mm); no pair overlaps in >= 95% of 300 random in-limit poses (max torso|shoulder_roll 11%) -> nothing may be excluded; every non-adjacent pair counts as penetration

floor.convention: output z = 0 is the calibrated floor; per clip (session) floor from the HUMAN source: median lowest foot point over quasi-static stance frames (umrf.labels.floor_from_points); floor_offset_removed stored in every output npz; ground gauge uses z of the floor-shifted pose

thresholds.note: human contact label uses the engine human rule (enter 1 cm / leave 2 cm on SMPL-X slots, same floor); robot rules are DATA_SPEC_v2 section 1 verbatim

quirks: H2 has no hand DoF: hands are rigid mitts (hand_link mesh); grasp = palm/finger-side contact of a rigid shell

surface region L/R_hand = wrist_roll subtree: includes the distal forearm tube (wrist_roll + wrist_pitch links, ~84/88 points); contact patch reassigns them to the forearm patch so a forearm touching a box does not count as hand contact

knee_link collision geom is a thin CYLINDER (r 2.5 cm, half-length 17.5 cm) while the visual shin reaches 4.4 cm (p50) / 7.9 cm (max) from the link axis -> MuJoCo knee/shin collision sits 2-5 cm inside the visual surface: a kneeling clip that is exact on the visual points leaves the physics shin 2-5 cm above the floor (sim would sink)
hip_roll collision geom is a 5 cm sphere (visual mesh larger)

no collision geom on hip_pitch_link (thigh, 76/82 pts), wrist_roll/wrist_pitch (forearm tube, 84/88 pts), waist_yaw/waist_roll/head_pitch (trunk 48 pts), ankle_roll (foot 3/2 pts): MuJoCo self/object cross-check is blind there; the dense-point gauge must cover them
qpos0 has elbows at 0 = forearms pointing forward horizontally (not arms-down)
UMR T-pose shipped with UMR (shoulder roll +-90 deg, elbow 90 deg) kept unchanged
foot sole is flat: 22/136 points within 2 mm of the floor at rest, sole patch 22.0 x 7.5 cm

qa_clips.note: kneel facing a chair, forearms on the seat: knee/shin + foot ground contact, forearm/hand object contact; private copy of smplx/hiphi/data/Change_posture/lean/Change_posture-lean_0025 + object_meshes/Chair_S_1.obj so the CoACD collision asset UMR builds is written under this pipeline
